title: #173 Harder Life
prompt: It is harder for children to grow up in the 21st century than it was in the past. How far do you agree with this statement? Give your opinions.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the statement that growing up in the 21st century is harder for children than in the past by examining modern challenges and comparing them to past experiences.
outline: body1: Discuss the impact of technology and digital saturation on children's development.
body2: Explore the effects of increased academic rigor and social pressure.
keyArguments: The rise of technology has introduced new challenges such as digital alienation and reduced parental involvement.
Modern pressures like academic rigor and social media contribute to stress and mental health issues among children.
